import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl

# Scan the parquet file lazily using Polars backend
lazy_df = pl.scan_parquet("events.parquet")

# Wrap with narwhals to get the lazy API
nw_lazy = nw.from_native(lazy_df)

# Build the lazy pipeline
pipeline = (
    nw_lazy
    .filter(nw.col("status") == "ok")
    .select("user", "duration")
)

# Materialize the pipeline into an in-memory DataFrame
result_df = pipeline.collect()

print(result_df)

import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl

# Scan the parquet file lazily using Polars backend
lazy_df = pl.scan_parquet("events.parquet")

# Wrap with narwhals to get the lazy API
nw_lazy = nw.from_native(lazy_df)

# Build the lazy pipeline
pipeline = (
    nw_lazy
    .filter(nw.col("status") == "ok")
    .select("user", "duration")
)

# Materialize the pipeline into an in-memory DataFrame
result_df = pipeline.collect()

print(result_df)
